title: This Man Had Hiccups For 68 Years 😮
caption:
This man had hiccups for 68 YEARS 😮
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In 1922 Charles Osborne of Iowa started hiccuping while lifting a hog. He hiccuped for 68 years, until 1990, a Guinness World Record. In between he married twice and had eight children.
What's your best hiccup cure? 👇
